paraphrase: To the sick Vakkali who longs to see him: 'Enough, Vakkali! Why do you want to see this foul body? Whoever sees the Dhamma sees me; whoever sees me sees the Dhamma'; and the aggregates are impermanent, so not fit to be regarded as self.

paraphrase: Vakkali, sick and in pain, uses the knife; the Buddha sees a cloud of smoke moving in all directions — Māra searching for Vakkali's consciousness — and declares that he attained final nibbāna with consciousness unestablished.
